checks.name: per-imported-mesh shadow material ownership
checks.detail: render.js creates customDepthMaterial and customDistanceMaterial for every imported mesh before candidate installation. Synthetic static resources are unchanged and continue to use their existing primitive materials.

checks.name: candidate failure cleanup
checks.detail: build catch calls disposeTree on the candidate root. disposeTree traverses ordinary, custom depth and custom distance materials, collects referenced textures/geometries and releases each once through Sets and a released root WeakSet.

checks.name: scene and cache disposal
checks.detail: Native trace observed each captured custom depth/distance material dispose once, all bitmap clones closed once, geometry count zero, and renderer texture count zero after renderer disposal.

checks.name: shadow presentation
checks.detail: shadow-on.png and shadow-off.png were captured from the fixed build. The scene stayed drawable with no page errors while toggling the directional shadow.

checks.name: eight-swap native trace
checks.detail: The original eight-look sequence no longer creates the stale shared-depth map texture. Settled texture counts repeat 4,4,3,4 across both halves. Remaining 3 textures before renderer disposal are the global shadow pair plus DFG LUT.

limitations: SwiftShader browser only, no physical-GPU or ordinary-PC performance claim.
The root owns runtime and main QA integration. This review did not modify runtime or QA.
